gloss: abstract copy; extract (of an official register)

definitions.gloss: abstract copy; extract of an official register
definitions.explanation: An official document that reproduces only the portion of a register relating to one person, as opposed to a copy of the whole register. Almost always used in compounds such as {戸籍|こせき}{抄本|しょうほん}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戸籍|こせき}→戸籍：12695_koseki⟧{抄本|しょうほん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: I need an abstract copy of my family register.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{抄本|しょうほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I got an abstract copy at city hall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戸籍|こせき}→戸籍：12695_koseki⟧{抄本|しょうほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一通|いっつう}→一通：26154_ittsuu⟧⟦{添|そ}えて→添える：13315_soeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please attach one abstract copy of your family register to the application.

notes:
A {抄本|しょうほん} extracts only the part of an official register relating to one person, while a ⟦{謄本|とうほん}→謄本：29796_touhon⟧ reproduces the entire register. Rarely used alone — it almost always appears in compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{戸籍|こせき}→戸籍：12695_koseki⟧{抄本|しょうほん}: abstract copy of a family register (one person's section)
- ⟦{住民票|じゅうみんひょう}→住民票：09628_juuminhyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{抄本|しょうほん}: abstract of a residence record
- {抄本|しょうほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to obtain an abstract copy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{謄本|とうほん}→謄本：29796_touhon⟧: certified full copy — reproduces the whole register, not just one person's part
